beats.text: On Rishyamukha, the exiled monkey king Sugriva saw two warriors approaching with bows. He feared his brother Vali had sent them to kill him.
So he sent his wisest minister, Hanuman, son of the wind god, to find out who they were.
Hanuman came disguised as a priest. He spoke so wisely and gently that Rama turned to Lakshmana in wonder.
'He has spoken for so long, without a single mistake,' Rama said. 'Only one who has mastered the Vedas could speak like this.'
Lakshmana told him everything: the exile, Sita, and Ravana.
Hanuman revealed his true form and fell at Rama's feet, knowing instantly who he was. His heart overflowed.
He grew large, lifted both brothers on his shoulders, and leapt up the mountain.
He carried them to Sugriva. A lifelong devotion had begun. From that day, Hanuman lived only for Rama.
